D: The Griswolds drive cross-country in the Family Truckster to get to Walley World.
P: Serve the snacks when they finally reach Walley World and find it closed.
S: Family Truckster sweet and salty trail mix
chips and lollies in the back seat

Honey-roasted peanuts, pretzels and cornflakes baked in butter and brown sugar, tossed through with chocolate buttons and dried cranberries for the back seat. Melt 60g butter with 60g brown sugar and 2 tbsp honey. Toss with 200g peanuts, 150g pretzel twists and 60g cornflakes on a lined tray with a pinch of salt. Bake at 160C for 15 minutes, stirring halfway. Cool completely, then toss through 150g chocolate buttons and 100g dried cranberries. Pack into paper bags or a lidded box.
Franks on sticks dipped in a batter of cornmeal, flour, sugar, egg and buttermilk, fried at 180C for 4 minutes, mustard.
Kansas cheese and chive corn fritters
the drive through Kansas corn country

Sweet corn fritters with cheddar and chives, fried crisp and golden, with a smoky chipotle sour cream for dipping. Mix 2 cups corn kernels (from 3 cobs) with 150g self-raising flour, 2 eggs, 125ml milk, 100g grated cheddar, chopped chives and salt. Heat 1cm oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Drop in heaped tablespoons and fry 2 minutes a side until golden. Drain on paper. Mix 200g sour cream with 1 chopped chipotle in adobo and a squeeze of lime for dipping.
M: Burnt ends: brisket point cubed, smoked or roasted, tossed in sweet barbecue sauce and brown sugar, back in the oven until sticky.
W: the park, finally, if it's open

Crisp apples on sticks dipped in glassy red toffee that cracks when you bite it, with a bag of fairy floss on the side. Push sticks into 4 apples. Boil 400g sugar, 125ml water and 1 tsp vinegar to 150C, then add a few drops of red colouring. Dip and twirl the apples and set on baking paper. Serve with a bag of fairy floss.
K: the Family Truckster across the country

Fresh lemon juice and strawberries blended with sugar syrup and topped with soda water, poured from a big ice-packed thermos into tin cups. Blend 250g strawberries with 150ml lemon juice (about 5 lemons) and 150ml sugar syrup until smooth. Strain into a jug. Add 1L cold water and 500ml soda water and stir. Pour into a large thermos packed with ice or a jug full of ice, with sliced strawberries and lemon.

s.how: Whisk 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk. Pat 8 franks dry and push onto sticks. Dip in the batter and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until deep golden. Serve with mustard.

m.how: Cut a 1.5kg brisket point into 4cm cubes and rub with smoked paprika and salt. Roast at 140C for 3 hours. Toss with 200ml barbecue sauce and 2 tbsp brown sugar and return to the oven for 30 minutes until sticky.
